import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a bar plot for the survival count by passenger class
sns.countplot(data=data, x='pclass', hue='survived', palette='Set2', ax=ax)

# Set title and labels
ax.set_title('Survival Count by Passenger Class', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)

# Add legend with title
ax.legend(title='Survived', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
